title: Lentor
summary: LENT'OR, noun [Latin from lentus, slow, tough, clammy.] 1. Tenacity; viscousness. 2. Slowness; delay; sluggishness. 3. Siziness; thickness of fluids; viscidity; a term used in the humoral pathology.
